services.title: Residential Closings
services.text: We provide smooth, stress-free residential closings.
services.lead: We provide smooth, stress-free residential closings. We have designated teams for each phase of the closing process, and the team members assigned to your particular file stay with you from start to finish.

services.title: Commercial Closings
services.lead: Our commercial closing staff has a combined closing experience of 50 years and are qualified to handle any commercial transaction from hotels, multi-unit properties, hospitals to vacant land. We routinely close complex, multi-million, and billion-dollar properties.

about.title: About Fidelity National Title
text: We are knowledgeable, creative, professional and adept at closing complex residential and commercial transactions. For four consecutive years, our team has won the Top Fee Attorney operation in Houston.

To serve as subject matter experts for all our clients, we remain on the cutting edge, staying engaged with changes and evolutions within the world of real estate and real estate closings. Visit our Resources portal to gain access to our blog, helpful links and frequently asked questions.
